correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 and every full-support tour law, the uniform moment calculation p=1/(n-1), q=1/((n-1)(n-2)) yields C=(p+q)I-q(B^TB+transpose)+(q-p^2)J. The crown-graph incidence kernel has dimension 2n-1 and nonzero symmetric/skew eigenvalues 1/(n-1), n/((n-1)(n-2)); full support fixes that nullspace for arbitrary positive weights. Extending a selected kernel vector by zero on F=E\S identifies its freedom with c(F)-1 alternating component potentials, including isolated vertices. Complementary orthogonal minors and incidence total unimodularity yield identical 4^d pdet(C)/tau determinants precisely for crown spanning-tree complements; the crown Laplacian gives tau=(n-1)n^(n-2)(n-2)^(n-1). Independently reconstructed exact rational spectra for n=3,4,5 and all 792 n=4 maximal principal minors: 384 positive equal 1/11664, 408 zero. Finite tests do not establish all n or all positive laws; the incidence/kernel proof does.
residual_risks: Equal determinant says nothing about individual selected condition numbers; all weights must be strictly positive; title theorem excludes undirected and looped tours.

value.rationale: A natural, distribution-robust exact classification of maximal independent arc Walsh-coordinate observations on Hamiltonian tours: it supplies all sizes, all maximal designs, their count, their exact common determinant, and their positive spectrum; researchers designing first-order tour measurements can need these precise values. Not credit for a routine tree enumeration alone.
residual_risks: A generalized graphical-design theorem using the same cut-space could partially subsume the claimed contribution.

limitations: All-n and arbitrary full-support measure claims rely on proof, not finite checks.
